entries.text: 这座校舍……\n充满了新鲜的气息。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_first_00

entries.text: 竟然邀请我来新的建筑物，\n你身份不一般啊！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_00

entries.text: 我本来一点兴趣都没有，\n是看在你的面子上才来的。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_01

entries.text: 呵呵呵……换句话说，\n你欠我一个人情了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_02

entries.text: 作为回报，\n我迟早会吩咐你为我做事的。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_03

entries.text: 怎么这样……
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 我明白了！
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 呵呵呵！这是你自己埋下的种子，\n你就好好祈祷丰收吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_05

entries.text: 哎呀？想不到你这么顺从。\n呵呵呵……可真是省心。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_05b

entries.text: 那么，要让你成为\n什么样的傀儡供我操纵呢……\r\n我从现在就开始期待了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp01_04

entries.text: 怎么，是你啊。\n你比以前古老的这几天又成了历史。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_00

entries.text: 之前我虽然不情不愿地远征来这里，\n但现在一想，这里是合众地区……\r\n是积淀了悠久历史的宝库啊！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_01

entries.text: 其中，沉睡在海底的古老遗迹\n真是令人好奇心洋溢啊！！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_02

entries.text: ……在这里的话，\n校长也看管不到，可真是省心。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_03

entries.text: 待会我就让宝可梦带我\n“哟呵～！”地游到那里探索吧！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_04

entries.text: 好像很有趣！
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 注意安全
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_select_02

entries.text:
呵呵呵！
我忍不住要好好享受一番了！\c
能受到考古式思考的刺激
可是无可替代的珍宝。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_05

entries.text: 呵呵呵，不必担心。\c\n如果能在遗迹和遗物的\n包围下结束生涯，此生无憾。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp02_05b

entries.text: 你怎么了？
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 你感觉不太好吗？
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 你看不出来吗？\n我太满足了，现在有些疲乏。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_01

entries.text: 呵呵呵，不，正相反……\n我太满足了，现在有些疲乏。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_01b

entries.text: 昨天我让霓虹鱼带我游到了\n合众的海底遗迹……[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_02

entries.text: 那里太……太棒了……\n实在是……太美妙了……[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_03

entries.text: 阻挡入侵者的古老装置！\n记载在墙壁上的古代文字！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_04

entries.text: 和古代的人们斗智，\n意义深刻，堪称美妙！[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_05

entries.text: 但是一口气到达遗迹最深处\n会浪费这个难得的机会。\r\n我打算慢慢地探索。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_sp03_06

entries.text: 我记得你是冠军，对吧……\n你要不要和我交换宝可梦？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_01

entries.text: 只要是冠军的宝可梦，\n不管是哪只应该都很能干。\r\n就和我的索财灵交换……如何？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_02

entries.text: 好，你就选一选宝可梦吧。\n最好能选一种有助于探索的。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_03

entries.text: 嗯，这个交换很棒。\c\n你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]……\n我会好好疼爱它的。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_01_04

entries.text: 确定是用你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]和\n我的索财灵来交换吗？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_02_03

entries.text:
……你手上能够行动的
宝可梦好像只有１只啊。\c
劝你先带着２只以上同行宝可梦
再欣然接受这次交换。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_03_00

entries.text: ……变卦在历史上也是常有之事。\n就让我抱着期待等你吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_03_01

entries.text: 那就用你所拥有的宝可梦和\n我所拥有的索财灵\r\n来交换吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_trade_04_00

entries.text: 一直待在室内的话，\n我会受不了这新鲜的气味……\r\n就当是转换心情，去外面对战吧？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_talkto_00

entries.text: ……没想到你这么没兴致啊。\n那我一个人去转换心情了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_cancel_00

entries.text: 呵呵呵，多么善良的孩子。\n那我们就奔赴沙场吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battlestart_01

entries.text: ……真没想到你这么难对付。\n看来你一路走的都是王道啊。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 如果……能利用你那份实力，\n那各种各样的遗迹和坟墓……\r\n我就都能尽情调查了……不是吗！？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 好……让我逗一逗你，\n这个饯别礼就赏给你了。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 那可是价值极高的东西。\n你就每晚一边感谢蕾荷老师，\r\n一边凝望它吧。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [EMPTY 59]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_reward_00

entries.text:
呵呵呵，你那份实力
果然大有用处。\c
这次也赏你诱饵……
哦不，我是说赏你饯别礼。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 希望你和蕾荷老师我一同孕育的历史\n能够成为不可替代的存在。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
即使你有实力，一旦傲慢起来，
就会被攻其不备导致败北……\c
你难道是想亲自体验
历史性的反转剧吗？[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: 你能驾驭灾祸之宝了吗？\c\n要是想放手的话，\n可以马上来找我商量哦。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_00

entries.text:
你真的进去过
帕底亚巨坑吗？\c
如果是真的，那我可要拘留你几天，
好把事情盘问个一清二楚……[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
生态巨蛋的确是
非常优秀的技术……\c
但我个人对这种缺乏历史，
并且被扭曲的自然毫无兴趣。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\n确实是很能干。\r\n它在我调查遗迹时派上用场了哦。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我的兴趣是
收集古老的东西。\c
你接手的索财灵以前会
向我索要古钱，让我很头痛。[VAR 0x0114(0027)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_history_randomtalk_04
